couplets.fa: فریب شیوه‌ی چشم تو آشنای من است
couplets.en: The guile in your eyes, well I know, Familiar to me, their deception.

couplets.fa: نسیم گیسوی جعدت گره گشای من است
couplets.en: The breeze from your hair, in tangles tossed, Eases my woes in its way.

couplets.fa: رهی که پای نهادی حریم خلوت ماست
couplets.en:
Where your foot has fallen, my retreat does rest, In this place, has been pressed.
Your way, a haven for my solitude's need, where years, my epochs walked in thought and in deed.

couplets.fa: که سالهاست همین خطه جای پای من است
couplets.en: ..where years, my epochs walked in thought and in deed

couplets.fa: ز آتشی که به پا کرده‌ای ندانستی
couplets.en: You're unaware of the inferno set in wake,

couplets.fa: نوای هر نی دل سوخته ز نای من است
couplets.en: Every sad reed's tune, my flute does make. Your spark, the cause of this sad sound, In my flute's lament, its source is found.

couplets.fa: امیر ملک وجود و انیس و مونس من
couplets.en: Amir Malek, You, my joy, my wealth, my heart's repose,

couplets.fa: به هر کجا که تو باشی همان سرای من است
couplets.en: Where You do reside, my spirit goes. In Your company, solace I do find, Your locale, my abode, in heart and mind.

couplets.fa: نگاه کردم و دیدم که دل به سینه‌ی تو
couplets.en: I gazed and saw, within your breast so true,

couplets.fa: چنان دل من سر گشته مبتلای من است
couplets.en: A heart like mine, with afflictions not few. Bewildered as my own, your heart does bear, The same burden of woe in our shared care.

couplets.fa: همیشه بی تو دل من بهانه میگیرد
couplets.en: Ever without you, my heart does find pleas,

couplets.fa: بهانه‌ای کن و باز که این دوای من است
couplets.en: Invent an excuse, return, bring me ease. In your absence, my soul does reasons seek, Your return, the remedy that I bespeak.

couplets.fa: کسی ز حال دل من خبر نمیگیرد
couplets.en: No soul inquires of my heart's weary state,

couplets.fa: ز خاطری که دگر شعر تر نمیگیرد
couplets.en: From a mind where once poetry did create, Now silent, dry, its verses no longer flow, Lost in a world where no one seeks to know.

couplets.fa: چنانکه دلبری آموختی وفا آموز
couplets.en: As coquetry you've mastered, now teach fidelity,

couplets.fa: که جز وفای تو این وصل سر نمیگیرد
couplets.en: For union's form needs faith's sincerity. In this bond, your loyalty must take its shape, Lest love's design should falter and escape.

couplets.fa: دلم هوای سفر دارد ای دریغا دل
couplets.en: My heart yearns to journey, oh, pity its plight,

couplets.fa: که بی حضور تو شوق سفر نمیگیرد
couplets.en: That finds no joy in travel without your light. For in your presence alone, it finds its grace, Without you, every journey loses its embrace.

couplets.fa: بیان درد جگرسوزت ای فرشته جان
couplets.en: O Angel of Life, in these lines I impart,

couplets.fa: یقین بدان که در این مختصر نمیگیرد
couplets.en: The tale of my heart's consuming, fiery dart. Yet know this truth, in brevity's verse confined, Its depth of pain, in full, can never be enshrined.

couplets.fa: دوای درد من این شعر های رنگین نیست
couplets.en: These lively verses, though fair, mend not my pain,

couplets.fa: بیا که مرغ دلم بی تو پر نمیگیرد
couplets.en: Come, for without you, my heart's bird is in chain. Its wings are stilled, in your absence, they rest, Only in your proximity, can it fly its best.

couplets.fa: تمام خاطره ها با تو رنگ می‌گیرد
couplets.en: With you, each memory takes on a vivid hue,

couplets.fa: چنان که عشق از این خوب تر نمیگیرد
couplets.en: For love, in its finest form, rings ever true.

couplets.fa: سکوت هر لب شیرین صدای وسوسه‌ای
couplets.en: In every sweet lip's silence, temptation does dwell,

couplets.fa: ترانه ای است که در هر هنر نمیگیرد
couplets.en: A song beyond art's reach, in its charm's spell. Uncaught in canvas or verse, its melody soars free, A siren's call, in silent charm, a mystery to see.

couplets.fa: می‌کُشد عشقِ جگر سوز تو آخر ما را
couplets.en: Your searing love, in time, shall be our end,

couplets.fa: عاشقِ سوخته‌ی شیفته‌ی شیدا را
couplets.en: A lover burnt, in infatuation's bend. Consumed by passion, frenzied and forlorn, In the blaze of your love, we're torn and worn.

couplets.fa: به خیالِ تو قسم بی‌تو دلم می‌گیرد
couplets.en: In thoughts of you, my heart does sorely pine,

couplets.fa: بی‌خیالِ تو، نخواهم همه دنیا را
couplets.en: Without your memory, the world loses its shine. Each heartbeat echoes with a deep yearn, For lacking your memory, the world I spurn.

couplets.fa: آمدی خانه‌ی تنهاییِ من ویران شد
couplets.en: You came, and lo! My lone abode did fall,

couplets.fa: تا که آباد کنی با قدمت فردا را
couplets.en: Your step did herald a brighter morrow's call. Your coming made the very ground to quake, A future lit by you, a tale to make.

couplets.fa: گاه لبخند تماشای صفِ مروارید
couplets.en: At times your smile, like pearls in perfect row,

couplets.fa: بی‌گمان باز کند دیده‌ی نابینا را
couplets.en: Bright and clear, to the sightless eyes does show. Undoubtedly, it lights the way, the dark to bind, With such radiance, even the blind's eyes find.

couplets.fa: چشم‌هایی که زلالند چنان آب بهشت
couplets.en: Eyes as lucid as paradise's waters serene,

couplets.fa: موجِ زلفی که به یغما ببرد دریا را
couplets.en: Amidst a wave of hair, like a sea, unseen. Their clarity rivals the purest ocean deep, In their gaze, secrets of celestial waters keep.

couplets.fa: این صدای سخنِ توست که در شعرِ من است
couplets.en: This is the sound of your voice in my verse,

couplets.fa: یاد هایی است چنین ماهرویِ زیبا را
couplets.en: Memories of such a moon-faced beauty, in my song I rehearse.

couplets.fa: قصه‌ی عشقِ تو پایان‌نپذیرد هیهات
couplets.en: The tale of your love, endless, brings such woe,

couplets.fa: همچو مجنون بکشم بارِ غمِ لیلا را
couplets.en: Like Majnun, Layla's grief upon me does bestow. In this unceasing tale, heavy it sits, Bearing the burden of a love that never quits.

couplets.fa: سارای مرا سیل نبرده‌است به جایی
couplets.en: The deluge has not born my Sarah away,

couplets.fa: خورشید نگیرد به سر انگشت بلایی
couplets.en: Nor does the sun in disaster's fingers sway. In flood, she remains untouched, unharmed, And in calamity, the sun's grace is not alarmed.

couplets.fa: آمد که کند خاک مرا لایق افلاک
couplets.en: It came to lift my dust to heaven's height,

couplets.fa: هم رفت که افلاک شود رنگ خدایی
couplets.en: And left, that heaven might bear God's light. To render my earthly form divine in worth, Then departed, coloring the heavens with mirth.

couplets.fa: ما دلشدگان جان به ره دوست فشانیم
couplets.en: We, the forlorn in love, our lives have lain, On the beloved's path amidst joy and pain.

couplets.fa: سودای وفا نه که به امید جفایی
couplets.en: Not with the hope of true faithfulness to find, But in the anticipation of betrayal unkind.

couplets.fa: پیوسته به گوش است مرا پند زمانه
couplets.en: By time's stern teachings, I am ever chided,

couplets.fa: شاهان ننشینند مقابل به گدایی
couplets.en: That kings to beggars are not seated, sided. In life's harsh course, this truth does clearly appear, High thrones and lowly grounds do not draw near.

couplets.fa: لبریز وصالم تهی از غربت هجران
couplets.en: Full am i with union, void of parting's grief,

couplets.fa: چون من همه اویم چه غم از داغ جدایی
couplets.en: For wholly hers I am, in love's firm belief. Of separation's sorrows, I take no heed, As in her hold, my heart has all it does need.

couplets.fa: سر تا سر هستی همه آیینه‌ی رویت
couplets.en: From start to finish, life does your visage reflect,

couplets.fa: هیهات ز دام تو تمنّای رهایی
couplets.en: Alas, from your snare, no release to expect. In every corner, your countenance see, From your entrapment, no hope to flee.

couplets.fa: دوست دارم بازوی حیدر شوم
couplets.en: I yearn to be as Haydar's arm, strong and sure,

couplets.fa: مردم آشفته را یاور شوم
couplets.en: To help the troubled souls, their burdens to endure. With strength and might, like Haydar in his grace, To offer aid, and solace in life's race.

couplets.fa: دوست دارم چون کبوترهای مست
couplets.en: I long to soar like pigeons, inebriated in flight,

couplets.fa: پرکشم زین عالم بیداد و پست
couplets.en: Far from this world unjust, lowly, escaping to the light. On wings unburdened, towards the skies so grand, Away from earthly toils, to a higher, freer land.

couplets.fa: چون نسیمی بگذرم از این جهان
couplets.en: As a breeze, through this world I'd lightly roam,

couplets.fa: رسم نامردی براندازم عیان
couplets.en: Boldly overturning customs that dishonor's home. With the wind's gentle might, yet firm in my quest, Challenging wrongful norms in pursuit of what's best.

couplets.fa: پرده‌ی ابهام هستی برکشم
couplets.en: I'd reveal the enigma of existence, clear and true,

couplets.fa: تا مگر خامُش شود این آتشم
couplets.en: In hopes this inner fire might be quenched anew. Lifting life's obscure veil to see its core, Perhaps to calm the flames that in me roar.

couplets.fa: راز خود با رازدان نجوا کنم
couplets.en: I'd share my hidden truths with those who know,

couplets.fa: تا کند از سرّ هستی آگهم
couplets.en: To grasp being's essence, in wisdom's glow. In whispered confidences with the understanding few, Seeking clarity, life's mysteries to construe.

couplets.fa: از میان آیه‌های گونه‌گون
couplets.en: Amidst the tapestry of varied verse,

couplets.fa: رمز بگشایم ز مالاتعلمون
couplets.en: I'd seek to unravel the unknown, diverse. Exploring the depths of 'what you know not, To uncover secrets in the poetic knot.

couplets.fa: وای ازین غربت سرای دلفریب
couplets.en: Alas, for this land of estrangement, so deceiving,

couplets.fa: زاغکی اندر نمای عندلیب
couplets.en: A crow dons the bulbul's guise, misleading, grieving. In this realm of illusion, where truths are concealed, False fronts are sung, their true nature unsealed.

couplets.fa: شیرها در دست روباهان اسیر
couplets.en: In foxes' grasp, the lion finds himself bound,

couplets.fa: مردم بی درد بر جانان امیر
couplets.en: While people stand aloof, as the noble suffers around. A world inverted, where the cunning lead the brave, And the masses unmoved, to the plight of the grave.

couplets.fa: دوست دارم یا بسازم این جهان
couplets.en: I yearn to either reshape this world's way,

couplets.fa: یا کنم در عالمی دیگر مکان
couplets.en: Or seek my abode in a realm far away. To mend what's here, or in new lands to dwell, In either quest, my spirit seeks to excel.

couplets.fa: ما و خیال یار و دل خود نشسته ایم
couplets.en: In our heart's abode, where joy is measured.

couplets.fa: وین خانه از غبار غم و غصه شسته‌ایم
couplets.en: This abode, now clean of sorrow's dusty grief, A haven of solace, in love's sweet relief.

couplets.fa: رام کسی نبود دلم وی عجب کنون
couplets.en: My heart once wild, unbound, and full of yearning.

couplets.fa: بر گیسوان یار چه آرام بسته‌ایم
couplets.en: Now in beloved's tresses, in peace it's turning. With gentle bonds, we've tied it soft and fair, In the locks of love, it rests with tender care.

couplets.fa: ضایع نبود هرچه به هجرش کشیده‌ایم
couplets.en: Not in vain, our trials in her absence borne,

couplets.fa: جان از تعلق همه عالم گسسته‌ایم
couplets.en: For in her parting, from worldly ties we're torn. Our soul's detachment, from earthly bonds set free, In her leaving, we found our true liberty.

couplets.fa: یارب بهشت، دیدن خوبان عالم است
couplets.en: O Lord! in the world's beauty, paradise we find,

couplets.fa: در انتظار دیدن رویش نشسته‌ایم
couplets.en: In gazing upon her face, in hope we sit and wait, In her visage's view, our bliss to culminate.

couplets.fa: همپای عشق و همسفر شور و عاطفه
couplets.en: Beside love, a comrade of fervor so bright,

couplets.fa: همچون کبوتر حرم احرام بسته‌ایم
couplets.en: Like sanctuary doves, in our pilgrim's garb dight. Together in journey, in love's sacred rite.

couplets.fa: داستان غم تو باد صبا میداند
couplets.en: Your tale of woe, the morn's breeze alone does ken,

couplets.fa: هر که در حلقه فتد قدر هوی میداند
couplets.en: Its whispers hold the secrets of your sorrow then. Who in love's snare does fall, their heart can tell, The truest worth of passion in that deep well.

couplets.fa: سبب خنده‌ی شیرین تو ای شیرین کار
couplets.en: O sweet doer, the cause of your smile so dear,

couplets.fa: سوز ما بود که دلدار روا می داند
couplets.en: Was the fire in our soul, to the beloved clear. That gentle burn, by your beloved seen right, A permissible flame, in her knowing sight.

couplets.fa: میل جاوید تو یک لحظه‌ی بارانی بود
couplets.en: Your lasting wish is but a fleeting rain,

couplets.fa: چشم بارانی ام آن را به خدا میداند
couplets.en: These eyes of tears, by God, does ascertain. A moment's shower, your deep desire so keen, In weeping gaze, this truth is ever seen.

couplets.fa: منم آن هزار فریاد شکسته در صدایی
couplets.en: I am those thousand shatters in a single cry,

couplets.fa: همه تار و پودم از عشق همه حال من هوایی
couplets.en: That crimson hush from Nineveh, thereby. In one voice, a multitude of screams do lie, A silence red, from ancient grounds, I signify.

couplets.fa: چو تو با غریبگانی، من و این همه غریبی
couplets.en: When you're with strangers, in their midst I stand, As all this foreignness, at your command.

couplets.fa: وگر آشنا پسندی ز ازل تو آشنایی
couplets.en: Yet if you seek comfort in what's well-known, From time immemorial, it's you I have shown.

couplets.fa: ز تو یادگاری من غم و حس مشترک بود
couplets.en: In recalling you, sorrow and feeling we share,

couplets.fa: ز من عشق و دل سپردن ز تو ناز و دلربایی
couplets.en: My part, devotion; yours, charm so fair. From my side, affection deep and true, From yours, enchantment in every hue.

couplets.fa: شب بی تو بودنم را همه با تو صبح کردم
couplets.en: Those evenings spent alone, in dreams I changed, To dawns with you, though in reality estranged.

couplets.fa: به خیال بگذرانم همه عمر در جدایی
couplets.en: In thought, my life in separation I do wend, Through imagination, with you I spend.

couplets.fa: نه شکایتی نمودم که به جور می فزایی
couplets.en: No word of grievance from my lips did flee, Yet you, in response, increased your cruelty.

couplets.fa: نه وفا طلب نمودم که تو تیغ می گشایی
couplets.en: No plea for faithfulness did I declare, But you, your sword of betrayal did bare.

couplets.fa: تو چو مریم مقدس چه لطیف و دلنشینی
couplets.en: As gentle and pure as the holy Mary so dear,

couplets.fa: به لباس مهرورزی و نشان پارسایی
couplets.en: In the robe of love and godliness, you appear. Your sweetness mirrors that of Mary, Clad in love and virtue and dignity.

couplets.fa: همچو مجنون شهره در دیوانگی
couplets.en: In madness's grip, as Majnun once was caught,

couplets.fa: می کشد آخر مرا ویرانگی
couplets.en: To a similar fate, my own ruin is brought. In insanity deep, as legend's lover was, My ruin's course by devastation's jaws.

couplets.fa: از غمت گفتم به دریا موج شد
couplets.en: I told the sea of my sorrow, and it turned to wave,

couplets.fa: کوفت سر بر ساحل بیگانگی
couplets.en: Striking its brow on the shore, so grave. Against the strand of estrangement, it did beat, Echoing my loneliness in every retreat.

couplets.fa: شمع جان را سوختم در کوی تو
couplets.en: In your lane, the candle of my soul I burned,

couplets.fa: یافتم بال و پر پروانگی
couplets.en: And in its flame, a moth's wings I discerned. Upon your path, my essence I did spend, Finding in the fire, a moth's fate to tend.

couplets.fa: قصه ی سوز جگر ناگفتنی است
couplets.en: The tale of the heart's blaze is beyond speech,

couplets.fa: همچنان چشم تو در فتانگی
couplets.en: As are your eyes in their guile, each. Inflamed in passion, yet mute in its cry, Like the wily look in your own eye.

couplets.fa: با که گویم قصه‌ی این غصه را
couplets.en: Whom shall I find, my sorrow to share,

couplets.fa: تا نیابم شیوه‌ی فرزانگی
couplets.en: Without crossing the line of sage care? In sharing this burden, heavy and grim, How to stay the course of wisdom's hymn?

couplets.fa: عاقبت این عشق بنیانم شکست
couplets.en: This love, it rent my foundation asunder,

couplets.fa: رشته تدبیر من از هم گسست
couplets.en: Shattered the threads of plans, cast them yonder. In its wake, my schemes are no more, Leaving me adrift on a strange, new shore.

couplets.fa: آنچه در افسانه خواندیم و سمر
couplets.en: In legends old and tales we oft peruse,

couplets.fa: عشق آمد با حیات من ببست
couplets.en: Love came to bind itself, not to refuse. To my life's thread, its fate it did choose, In woven tales, its presence it imbues.

couplets.fa: هر که گفت افسانه است این عشق کاش
couplets.en: Who claims love's but a fable, void and bleak,

couplets.fa: عاشقی می دید و با او می نشست
couplets.en: I wish they'd sit with lovers who do seek, To share their heart, their truth, not mild or meek, In such company, the true love they'd speak.

couplets.fa: ناله های سوزناکش می شنید
couplets.en: So they might hear the sad cries that soar,

couplets.fa: فاش میدید آنچه می گویند هست
couplets.en: And witness love's truth knocking at the door. Clearly see that what's spoken is no lore, But a deep existence, felt to its very core.

couplets.fa: آن شب که آسمان همه رقص ستاره بود
couplets.en: That night, when stars in heaven twirled, wondrously lit,

couplets.fa: گویی مرا تولد ماهی دوباره بود
couplets.en: A fresh lunar light, upon me did sit. I seed a new moon for me, in sky unfuried.

couplets.fa: احساس می وزید و دل از جای می رمید
couplets.en: Emotion surged, and heart did trace, To where its home, its rightful space,

couplets.fa: نقش حقیقی که چنان استعاره بود
couplets.en: A vision of truth, metaphorical, In image form, profound, allegorical.

couplets.fa: دستی پر از محبت و چشمی پر از نگاه
couplets.en: A hand brimmed with tender love's glow, An eye, with gaze that pierces so,

couplets.fa: بر آن جمال کار من و دل نظاره بود
couplets.en: Upon such beauty, my work and heart attend, In watchful awe, where admiration and art blend.

couplets.fa: پنهان روانه می شد و آرام می گذشت
couplets.en: It moved in secret, silent in its glide, O'er sleepers resting, flowing like the tide,

couplets.fa: بر خفتگان هر آنچه نمی ماند چاره بود
couplets.en: What lingered then, in quiet's deep conclusion, Was but the answer, in dream's sweet illusion.

couplets.fa: می ماند دل به حسرت و آه و دریغ و درد
couplets.en: The heart, in longing, sighed with deep regret, With pain, it dwelled where sorrows met,

couplets.fa: در عمق سینه هم جگری پاره پاره بود
couplets.en: In the chest's depths, another heart lay riven, Torn apart, by grief's harsh edicts given.
